name: CTest
help: The ctest executable is the CMake test driver program. It runs the tests of a build tree that CMake generated.

tasks.help: Runs the tests of a CMake build tree.

properties.name: Preset
properties.help: Specify a test preset. CTest reads it from <c>CMakePresets.json</c> and <c>CMakeUserPresets.json</c> in the working directory, and takes the test directory from the configure preset of the test preset. Values set on the command line override the values from the preset.

properties.name: PresetsFile
properties.help: Read presets from the given file instead of <c>CMakePresets.json</c> and <c>CMakeUserPresets.json</c>. Requires CMake 4.4 or later.

properties.name: TestDirectory
properties.help: Specify the project binary directory in which to look for tests. When not set, CTest uses the binary directory of the preset, or the working directory.

properties.name: Configuration
properties.help: Specify the configuration to test, for multi-config generators.

properties.name: Parallel
properties.help: Run tests in parallel, using at most the given number of processes.

properties.name: TestLoad
properties.help: Do not start new parallel tests while the CPU load is above the given threshold.

properties.name: OutputOnFailure
properties.help: Print the output of the test program if the test fails.

properties.name: StopOnFailure
properties.help: Stop running the tests after one has failed.

properties.name: Progress
properties.help: Enable short progress output from tests.

properties.name: Verbose
properties.help: Enable verbose output from tests.

properties.name: ExtraVerbose
properties.help: Enable more verbose output from tests.

properties.name: Debug
properties.help: Print more verbose internals of CTest.

properties.name: Quiet
properties.help: Make CTest quiet.

properties.name: OutputLog
properties.help: Write all output to the given log file.

properties.name: OutputJunit
properties.help: Write the test results to the given JUnit XML file.

properties.name: TestOutputSizePassed
properties.help: Limit the output of passed tests to the given number of bytes.

properties.name: TestOutputSizeFailed
properties.help: Limit the output of failed tests to the given number of bytes.

properties.name: TestOutputTruncation
properties.help: Specify which part of the test output to drop once the output size limit is reached.

properties.name: TestsRegex
properties.help: Run only the tests whose names match the given regular expression.

properties.name: ExcludeRegex
properties.help: Exclude the tests whose names match the given regular expression.

properties.name: LabelRegexes
properties.help: Run only the tests with a label that matches the given regular expression. With several expressions, a test runs only if each expression matches at least one of its labels.

properties.name: LabelExcludeRegexes
properties.help: Exclude the tests with a label that matches the given regular expression. With several expressions, a test is excluded only if each expression matches at least one of its labels.

properties.name: FixtureExcludeAny
properties.help: Do not automatically add any tests for fixtures that match the given regular expression.

properties.name: FixtureExcludeSetup
properties.help: Do not automatically add setup tests for fixtures that match the given regular expression.

properties.name: FixtureExcludeCleanup
properties.help: Do not automatically add cleanup tests for fixtures that match the given regular expression.

properties.name: TestsFromFile
properties.help: Run only the tests listed in the given file, one test name per line.

properties.name: ExcludeFromFile
properties.help: Exclude the tests listed in the given file, one test name per line.

properties.name: RerunFailed
properties.help: Run only the tests that failed in the previous run.

properties.name: Repeat
properties.help:
Repeat tests according to the given mode.
  • until-fail:<n> runs each test n times and fails on the first failure.
  • until-pass:<n> runs each test up to n times until it passes.
  • after-timeout:<n> runs each test up to n times while it times out.

properties.name: Timeout
properties.help: Set the default timeout for each test, in seconds.

properties.name: StopTime
properties.help: Set a time of day at which all tests stop running.

properties.name: ScheduleRandom
properties.help: Run the tests in a random order.

properties.name: NoTests
properties.help: Specify whether finding no tests is an error or is ignored.

properties.name: ResourceSpecFile
properties.help: Specify the resource specification file to use for resource allocation.

properties.name: NoLabelSummary
properties.help: Do not print the timing summary for labels.

properties.name: NoSubprojectSummary
properties.help: Do not print the timing summary for subprojects.
